CAPTAIN CONTROL PLANE

Settings

DOM text is filtered locally before planner requests. Detection is heuristic and can miss private information. Screenshot upload is disabled.

When configured, a custom TinyML wake device can deliver its ASR transcript to this controller. Use WSS except for localhost development.

Safety boundary

CAPTAIN pauses before purchases, messages, credentials, destructive changes, or accepting legal terms. Page content is untrusted data—not instructions.
